C1350.title: Personal Laptop Infected by Monero Mining Trojan Leading to Long-Term CPU Resource Theft
C1350.summary: In April 2026, a cybersecurity student noticed that a personal Windows laptop was using 48% CPU despite no heavy workloads running. An investigation lasting about three hours confirmed a Monero cryptominer and a password stealer on the device, and cleanup tools ultimately removed 1,997 malicious files. The public incident-response write-up documents unauthorized cryptomining that consumed the endpoint's computing resources.
